finding.text: The two links this diff adds point to a section that doesn't exist: `test/refresh.mjs:12` and the `Sheet.keep_on_reload` comment (`ext/drawer/Sheet.js:37`) both name `ux/Dictate/doc/debug-tab.md#refresh-then-dictate`, but on `worktree/dictation-solid` that doc has no such heading. The diff doesn't touch the doc at all, so step 2's cause and fix (the pill covering the mic, the 1 s deferred reload, the two starts at once, the worklet retry) are written down only in `session.jsonl` log lines.

`dev/Socket/readme.md:27` is now stale: it says the pill "never reloads by itself", yet `defer()` still reloads by itself once the page has been quiet `QUIET_MS` (30 s). The readme also doesn't mention the new `QUIET_MS`, the `stash` event or `socket.restored` (Socket.js:19, :263, :276). Anyone reusing them would have to read the code.

`test/refresh.mjs` isn't indexed. `ux/Dictate/readme.md:3` and `:17` list the proofs (`stall`, `debug-tab`, `deltas`, `sheet-steps`, `reconnect`) without it, and `test/files.jsonl` has no `refresh` row.

A fresh agent couldn't continue from this folder. Steps 3 and 4 aren't built. The log says they are "prepared as patch scripts (Temp/solid/patch3-5.mjs) plus the new DictateDebug.js/.css … test/errors.mjs", but no `Temp/solid` exists in the repo or in worktree `qf-8`. Step 2 (c3056d659, a1ddb7c89) is unmerged, there is no `show:` line for it, and `shots/` doesn't exist. Commit that prepared work, or note in the folder where it is.

The `deferred` scenario overclaims (`test/refresh.mjs:117`). It waits only 6 s, then reports "no reload by itself, the pill waits for the owner", but the page does reload by itself at 30 s. Either reword the line ("not within 6 s"), or make the deferred reload wait for the pill, which is what the readme promises.

`Dictate.again` is cleared only on the Whisper branch of `stop()` (Dictate.js:373). With the browser engine, a press during `transcribing` leaves it `true`. The next Whisper stop would then restart the mic without being asked. One line, `this.again = false` in `start_now()`, closes it.

`DictationBar.note` is a class-wide static (DictationBar.js:22), so every bar on the page shows the "page reloaded" reason, and any mic starting clears it for all of them. That's fine with one sheet bar. A per-bar note would be safer if the drawer and the sheet both mount bars.

The diff is simple and targeted. Each change answers one cause the test found (the pill moved, the reload waits until the page is quiet, start runs one at a time, the worklet load retries, `chunks` exists from the start), and `proof/refresh-5-runs.txt` shows all 6 scenarios passing 5 runs in a row, exit 0. I found nothing simpler.
